description: CWI's micropayment API selling real catalog / product / ledger / intelligence data per call, settled in USDC via the x402 protocol (exact scheme, EIP-3009). TESTNET PILOT: Base Sepolia only. The public x402.org facilitator is testnet-only; Base mainnet requires the owner's CDP facilitator key plus explicit owner approval and is NOT live. The server holds no private keys and cannot sign anything.

dns_txt.note: Not yet published: we do not control DNS for github.io, so no _x402 TXT record can be set here. When the API gets a public host on a domain we control (e.g. cumulativeweb.com), publish: _x402.<domain> TXT "v=x402-1; wk=https://<host>/.well-known/x402; k=resource-server; net=eip155:84532; scheme=exact" per Section 4 of the draft.
dns_txt.record_format: v=x402-1; wk=<manifest URL>; k=<kind>; net=<network>; scheme=<scheme>

discovery.note: Directories are optional caches over this manifest (draft Section 1): a consumer resolves this host's x402 capability with one HTTPS GET. This manifest is the authoritative, machine-readable record.

name: CWI Agent Deck x402 API

pricing.pay_to_note: payTo in live 402 challenges is a locally generated test-only address (Sepolia funds are play money). The owner must replace it with their own address before any real use.

Read the hash-chained Gear Ledger; optional chain verification.

service_note: No public base URL yet: the API runs as a private pilot (127.0.0.1:4021 on the owner's VM). Public reach via owner tunnel or hosted deploy is pending owner approval. Per the draft, resource 'url' entries MUST be HTTPS on the manifest's own domain — no URL is listed here because none truthfully exists yet; the 'path' values are the real route paths and become full URLs once a public base is provisioned.
